__doc__: SOT-1459 per-role worker assignment. Editable file (NOT .env) mapping each harness role to the worker that handles it. Valid roles: task-check | decomposition | implementation | verification | acceptance | github | linear-report. Valid workers: claude | codex | antigravity. Edit a value to reroute that role to a different worker; the run scripts (scripts/ai/run_codex.sh, scripts/ai/run_antigravity.sh) honor it when invoked with WORKER_ROLE=<role>. If a role's worker is not this script's worker (e.g. verification set to claude/antigravity), the script exits with non-response code 75 and Claude Code takes over per the Worker Non-Response Fallback Policy. github (branch/PR/merge) and linear-report (Linear state sync + progress reporting) are Claude-owned by default; reassigning them to codex/antigravity routes that role's worker-script invocation accordingly. Precedence: the global env kill-switches ALL_CLAUDE_MODE and WORKER_MODE still override this file; this per-role config is evaluated after them and before the individual disable flags / usage-limit cooldown. Keys starting with __ are ignored.
